nodes.name: data_alpha.json
nodes.summary: Lightweight data-generation method config for the synthesize pipeline: 3 short (2s) rollouts at 3Hz under mild domain randomization, with no injected model or sensor noise. Represents the smallest/fastest tier of a data-generation series (alpha/beta/gamma) likely used for quick smoke-testing of trajectory synthesis.

nodes.name: data_beta.json
nodes.summary: Medium-scale data-generation method config: 10 rollouts of 2s duration at 10Hz under the same domain-randomization ranges as data_alpha, with no injected noise. The middle tier of the alpha/beta/gamma data-generation progression.

nodes.name: data_gamma.json
nodes.summary: Largest-scale data-generation method config: 20 rollouts of 3s duration at 10Hz with the same domain-randomization ranges as alpha/beta, producing the most extensive training dataset in the alpha/beta/gamma progression.

nodes.name: eval_challenged.json
nodes.summary: Evaluation method config for a 'challenged' scenario: 10 rollouts with wider initial-condition randomization than the nominal case plus injected sensor noise (large position/attitude std) and no model noise, used to stress-test a trained policy under perturbed starting conditions and noisy measurements.

nodes.name: eval_extreme.json
nodes.summary: Most demanding evaluation method config: combines wide initial-condition randomization with both model (process) noise and sensor noise at the largest magnitudes of the eval_* set, used to test worst-case policy robustness.
nodes.languageNotes: The 10-element mean/std arrays for model and sensor noise likely correspond to per-channel noise on a drone state vector (e.g., position, attitude, and rate/velocity terms), scaled independently for each channel.

nodes.name: eval_mocap.json
nodes.summary: Evaluation method config modeling realistic motion-capture sensor noise: 10 rollouts with wide initial-condition randomization and small, hardware-realistic sensor noise standard deviations (no model noise), used to evaluate a policy under conditions approximating a real mocap-equipped test rig.

nodes.name: eval_nominal.json
nodes.summary: Baseline evaluation method config: 10 rollouts under the same mild domain-randomization ranges used for data generation, with no injected model or sensor noise, serving as the nominal/clean-condition benchmark against which challenged, extreme, and mocap evaluations are compared.

nodes.name: eval_single.json
nodes.summary: Minimal evaluation method config for a single deterministic rollout: randomization ranges and initial-condition perturbation are zeroed out and no noise is injected, used for debugging or visualizing one clean trajectory rather than statistical evaluation.
